steps.label: Eligible Entity Check
steps.caption: System validates foreign corporation status or transfer pricing scope.

steps.label: Draft Formulation
steps.caption: Assessing officer prepares proposed variations with tax schedules.

steps.label: Mandatory Forwarding
steps.caption: Officer transmits statutory draft order without demand notice.

steps.label: Statutory Protection
steps.caption: Omission of draft order renders entire assessment void ab initio.

steps.label: Draft Order Receipt
steps.caption: Corporate assessee receives draft assessment order via tax portal.

steps.label: Thirty Day Window
steps.caption: Assessee reviews proposed adjustments within thirty calendar days.

steps.label: Form Thirty Five A
steps.caption: Appellant prepares electronic objections with economic paper book.

steps.label: Parallel Lodgment
steps.caption: Objections are lodged simultaneously with panel secretariat and officer.

steps.label: Collegiate Intake
steps.caption: Three senior commissioners assemble to evaluate corporate objections.

steps.label: Oral Hearing
steps.caption: Taxpayer counsel argues economic comparability before collegiate bench.

steps.label: Enhancement Safeguard
steps.caption: Panel gives reasonable opportunity before enhancing any variation.

steps.label: Statutory Limitation
steps.caption: Panel must issue binding directions within nine months of draft month.

steps.label: Directions Receipt
steps.caption: Assessing officer receives binding directions from panel secretariat.

steps.label: One Month Deadline
steps.caption: Officer must complete assessment within one month from receipt month.

steps.label: Final Assessment
steps.caption: Officer passes final order in strict conformity with directions.

steps.label: Tribunal Gateway
steps.caption: Taxpayer appeals directly to appellate tribunal without first appeal.

steps.label: Limitation Watchdog
steps.caption: Engine calculates precise deadline for collegiate panel directions.

steps.label: Draft Order Audit
steps.caption: System flags illegal premature assessment orders with demand notices.

steps.label: Economic Verification
steps.caption: Engine compares transfer pricing adjustments against arm length margins.

steps.label: Tribunal Notice Alert
steps.caption: Platform schedules direct tribunal appeal upon final order delivery.
